name: Ancient Elven Waystone
description: A tall grey stone in a ring of old oaks, carved from root to crown with elven script. It hums, very faintly, if you stand close.

discovery.message: Through the trees, a tall carved stone stands alone in a ring of ancient oaks.

the-stone.text: The waystone's carvings are worn almost smooth. A small basin at its foot holds clear rainwater. When the wind drops, you can almost hear something.

choices.label: [Elf] Lay your hand on the stone and listen.
Chant the verses of the first dawn and offer the moon essence.

listen.text: You press your palm to the cold stone and wait, breathing slowly, until the forest sounds fall away.
listen.success_text: Under everything, a song: thin, broken, missing half its notes. And a voice inside it, speaking to you.
listen.failure_text: Just wind in the oaks. Maybe another time, when the forest is quieter.

the-chant.text: You hold up the shard. Its pale light meets the stone's, and you begin the verses Mother Muriel taught you, the ones the elves sang at the first dawn.
the-chant.success_text: The words come right. The shard melts into the carvings like water into sand, and the stone begins, quietly, to sing.
the-chant.failure_text: You lose the verse, and the stone's light flickers. Steady yourself.

chant-retry.text: The shard is still warm in your hand.

drink.text: The water is sweet and very cold. Your tiredness fades.

leave.text: The waystone's hum follows you a little way into the trees.
